title: Forcing battle initiative for actor or enemy on scripted battles

posts.author: Klunky2
posts.body:
Hey there I wonder if it's a basic Maker function I know it was one of the RPG-Maker 2000 but in MV I can't find it and so I couldn't find anyone asking here.
I simply wanna decide that the either the hero or the enemy has the battle advantage (which means acting first) depending on certain factors. The fights are scripted and I use the normal battle system of the MV.
Does someone know how to enforce a battle initiative for either the actor or the enemy?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: Yanfly's Force Advantage plugin lets you control that; it is a part of his paid pack, I'm not sure of a free alternative off the top of my head.
